name: quant-3d-sharpe-viz
description: Marketplace for Sharpe Observatory: a Sharpe/alpha stock screen with a multiple-testing luck correction and a 3D skyline view.

plugins.name: sharpe-observatory
plugins.description: Screen a stock universe (bundled sample, S&P 500 or the full US market) by Sharpe ratio and Jensen's alpha with a multiple-testing luck correction (Probabilistic and Deflated Sharpe), then render the result as a 3D skyline: a PNG via matplotlib or Blender, or an interactive three.js page. Offline sample data by default; not investment advice.
